outcome: The Control Panel is now terse, data-first and locally cleaned up
owner_impact: The four primary Control Panel areas no longer carry explanatory prose. Current Experiment, Revisions, Save & share and Research curation use headings plus controls/data only. Numbered revisions show only the revision number in the compact trigger; Working copy shows W, while full meaning remains available to assistive technology. Research curation no longer contains explanatory paragraphs; dynamic counts/statuses remain concise. The local audit also removes stale Control Panel glue from earlier control relocations.

next.text: This bounded #273 Control Panel pass is complete. Review the live panel visually. #273 and #425 remain living but dormant; no repo-wide refactor has been activated.

technical_evidence: The Control Panel header help sentence and all four primary task subtitles are removed; taskHeading now renders title-only headings.
Static Showcase and Capability-request explanatory paragraphs are removed from Research curation; pending counts and operational status remain data/status only.
The numbered revision trigger renders only String(revisionNumber), with a compact 52–72px control sized for three digits; descriptive revision context is retained in aria-label.
Working copy uses W in the compact trigger and keeps its base revision in aria-label.
Visible revision/save state is compressed to terse values such as Saved, Historical, Working and pending rather than explanatory sentences; the verbose registry note is hidden in the Control Panel.
Save & share moves only the share row and save-as-new form that still belong there; obsolete save-row and Move placement selectors are removed.
Save-as-new relabeling now targets the relocated authoritative button directly instead of its obsolete registry-save-actions location.
Showcase dirty-state publishing now targets the authoritative Save Revision button in Revisions instead of the obsolete registry-save-actions selector.
No science/runtime, auth, revision/Working-copy/autosave, sharing, Showcase publication, capability-request or collection-organization semantics changed.
